lastCompletedStory.title: Prove the bare-submit remediation against a real tmux pane

nextStoryContext: The raw-echo real-tmux fixture now accepts drop-first, which leaves the first payload-bearing Enter unsubmitted and submits on subsequent Enter bytes. The new ninth skipIf(!tmuxAvailable)-guarded test observes the payload in the real composer before the first bare remediation, records real display-message geometry changing then returning to baseline, and proves one payload send plus one Enter-only remediation emits a single push-recovered event. The busy-pane test still uses the same payload-counting helper with two bare remediations and terminal retriesExhausted:3 metadata.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current tmux documentation confirms -L isolates servers, send-keys accepts sequential key arguments with Enter recognized as a key, and capture-pane -p reads visible pane content; the private-socket real-pane fixture and Enter-only remediation assertions align.
